spec_comment.body:
# Spec
Chosen: store sessions server-side.

**Punt:** Redis vs Postgres for the session store — needs a human to pick before build.

thread.author: lead
thread.body: Resolved: use Postgres for the session store — we already run it for every other persistence site and don't want a second datastore to operate.

thread.author: ops
thread.body: Note: the Postgres connection pool is capped at 20 on staging, keep that in mind for session-heavy load.
